description: 2004-2013 Parking Enforcement is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. Annual statistics about operations of the Parking Enforcement division of Public Works. In 2014, the Parking Enforcement division of Public Works became part of the Bloomington Police Department. Includes: Annual Budget, Number of Employees, Violations Issued, Amounts Collected. Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The portal files it under the category Public Works. The table has 18 columns. Attribution on the portal: Public Works. The portal shows 2023-05-17 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
